run_train_model: run a pycls classification model training job using a config file and GPU count
run_test_model: run a pycls classification model evaluation on a test set using a config file
run_model_info: run a pycls model to print its architecture and complexity metrics
run_time_model: run a pycls model timing benchmark across multiple GPUs using a config file
run_scale_model: run a pycls model scaler to adjust complexity and dump the scaled config
